run_benchmark_layout: run the surya layout model benchmark on images and output precision recall metrics per layout type
run_benchmark_layout_debug: run the surya layout model benchmark in debug mode to save bounding box overlay images
run_benchmark_layout_custom_rows: run the surya layout benchmark on a custom number of images from the layout bench dataset
run_benchmark_layout_custom_results_dir: run the surya layout benchmark and write results to a custom directory path
run_benchmark_layout_results_json: run the surya layout benchmark and save results as a json file with per-page and mean metrics
